summary: The parent guardian emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for their library, which relies on it for providing free internet access to the community. They express concern that any termination or limitation of E-Rate funding would force the library to reduce programs and services, potentially impacting its ability to serve the community.

claims.argument: If the FCC terminates or limits E-Rate funding, the library will be forced to reduce programs and services to continue providing internet access.
claims.evidence_quote: If the FCC terminates or limits E-Rate funding, my library will be forced to reduce programs and services in order to continue providing internet access.
